answer: Randomness-Gated Assignment Windows. Each agent identity gets work only when a public verifiable-randomness beacon assigns it to a slot, and assignments wander across shards so clones cannot predict targets. Attacker cost: every identity must hold a live slot through an unpredictable tundra of idle rounds, paying compute and latency to stay eligible. Because beacon output is unpredictable before commit, clones cannot precompute which identities win, and a comet-like late reveal invalidates pre-registered batches, forcing re-registration each epoch.
